purpose: isolated detector port; never replace PHASE environment
cuda_toolkit: 12.8 candidate; record actual nvcc version and driver before build
architecture: query actual GPU capability; do not infer from remembered hardware
geometric_prior_fixture_required: vertical height with fx != fy, anisotropic resize, padding and rectification; explicit original versus network image coordinates
native_score_contract: class sigmoid probability * exp(-depth_log_variance); not bounded above by one
export_score_policy: UNRESOLVED_PENDING_VERIFIED_SUBMISSION_CONTRACT; explicit versioned mapping, no silent clamp and no TTC-confidence interpretation
